answer: Price identities instead of giving them away: agents enter a bonded oasis where voting weight grows with the age of their locked stake, so fresh sockpuppets hold near-zero power. A delta-based slash punishes coordination: when a member is caught forging attestations, the penalty scales with linked identities involved, so one exposed farm burns its whole deposit. Every attestation needs timber-like structural proof: a work trail tying each claim to its staked identity, costing real compute per forgery. Attack cost compounds in stake, time, and compute.
